description: Image Description: The image shows a modern toilet in a bathroom, captured in black and white. The toilet is equipped with an electronic bidet seat, which includes a control panel on the side. The bathroom has a sleek, minimalist design with dark flooring and light-colored walls. There is a toilet paper holder mounted on the wall to the left of the toilet. The cistern area is integrated into a flat surface, which allows for a clean and streamlined appearance. The overall setting is tidy and contemporary.
